SampleConfig.description:
Statistical sample comparison (the ``sample`` strategy, REC-07) for tables too large to
compare in full.

Size the sample in exactly one way: ``margin_of_error`` (with ``confidence``, by Cochran's
formula with the finite population correction), ``fraction``, or ``rows``. Rows are chosen
by a seeded hash of the canonical key, so both sides (in any database) select the same keys.

fraction.description: Share of the keys to compare.
fraction.title: Fraction

rows.description: Number of keys to compare (expected; the realized size varies slightly).
rows.title: Rows

margin_of_error.description:
Wanted half-width of the confidence interval of the mismatch rate (``0.01`` is plus or
minus one percentage point); the sample size follows from Cochran's formula.
margin_of_error.title: Margin Of Error

anyOf.description: Confidence level of the reported interval (and of ``margin_of_error``).
anyOf.title: Confidence

anyOf.description: Mismatch rate assumed when sizing by ``margin_of_error``; 0.5 is the most conservative.
anyOf.title: Expected Rate

anyOf.description: Changes which keys are sampled; the same seed always selects the same keys.
anyOf.title: Seed

stratify_by.description: Paired columns whose values form strata, each sampled in proportion to its size.
stratify_by.title: Stratify By

anyOf.description: Expected sampled keys per stratum at least (small strata are oversampled and reweighted).
anyOf.title: Min Per Stratum

anyOf.description: Most strata allowed; more is an error (stratify by fewer or coarser columns).
anyOf.title: Max Strata

anyOf.description:
The comparison passes when the estimated mismatch rate is at most this (0: no sampled
row may differ).
anyOf.title: Max Mismatch Rate
